notablePrerequisites: At least six additional creatures in graveyard and/or on the battlefield.
description:
Cast Wake the Past by paying {5}{R}{W}, returning all nonland permanents from your graveyard to the battlefield and giving them haste.
Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, returning Wake the Past from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar seven times by sacrificing Archaeomancer and six other creatures, adding seven {W}.
Repeat.
